title: 第1章 退婚商红尘第2章 混元道境第二层
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 大齐王朝。
龙蛇城。
三月的温柔吹皱了灿烂的天，一个少年坐在山上，他的面前是一个少女，少女持剑而立，旁边的树摇晃落下了几片翠绿的树叶，少女的剑已经出鞘，树叶被切割成两半，整齐的切口洋溢着剑气的凌厉。
少女目光寒冷，不过二八年龄的她，剑指少年，美眸竖起，冷冷道：“陈初阳，我和你是不可能的，我不可能嫁给你，也不可能一辈子窝在小小的龙蛇城。”
眼前的少年名为陈初阳，他闻言微微抬起了眼眸，扫了一眼少女。
平淡而不起波澜的回来，没有想象中的怒火和暴跳如雷，那一声哦让商红尘眉头紧皱，她眼神更加凌厉，剑气，欲要破剑而出。
少女往前一步，气势压迫。
“陈初阳，我跟你说正事呢，你能不能认真一点，我要离开龙蛇城，我不可能和你成亲，这一次来，我是来找你退婚的，你我之间，绝对不可能，所以，之前我父亲所定下来的婚约无效。”
单方面通知，不需要他同意。
商红尘的目的不言而喻，陈初阳抬起头，再次应了一声：“哦。”
少女炸了，她又往前一步，手里的剑距离陈初阳不过一个拳头的距离，再往前一点，就会刺破少年的脖子，从而丧命，少女对距离的把控十分美妙，卡在了这个距离，既能够威胁陈初阳，又可以让他难受，不敢反抗。
少女的意志坚定，两人之间的婚约，也是非退不可。
陈初阳看着眼前的少女，商红尘，商家的大小姐，也是龙蛇城有名的美女，不少年轻弟子的梦中情人，陈家和商家乃是盟友，两家的交情持续到了百年前，每一代的家主都会定下一些婚约，以此来增加彼此的情谊。
正好陈初阳和商红尘的年龄相仿，两人同一年出生，就被定下了婚约。
两人也算是青梅竹马，只是陈初阳比较宅，几乎都待在陈家的山里面，种种田，养养鱼，专心做自己的事情，他本不是这个世界的人，乃是从另一个世界穿越而来，睁开眼就成为了婴儿，历经了十几年的悲剧生活，他终于是成年了。
一直都在隐藏自己成年人的各种意识，生怕被当成了怪物，也不敢表现得太明显，所以他总是喜欢一个人生活，觉得那些人过于幼稚，自然就有了陈初阳是个普通人的消息，很普通的那种。
这个世界是修炼的世界，当陈初阳了解到这些的时候，他也如其他人一样踏入了修炼之路，只是，他的修炼之路不一样，和其他人很不一样。
眼前的少女可是龙蛇城有名的天才，一身天赋，很吓人，乃是龙蛇城内数一数二的存在，听说被一些门派青睐，要收为弟子，然后，有了眼前这一幕。
“陈初阳，你答应了？”
商红尘有些欣喜，本以为这条路会很难，她父亲可不同意退婚，毕竟这关乎到两家的关系，而且，陈初阳只是个普通人，并不是废物，也不是什么放荡子弟，也算是达到了他的标准。
婚约定下来的是两人成年之后就举行婚礼，这不，还差几个月就要开始准备结婚事宜，商红尘不愿意，她要退婚，被拒绝之后，她自己前来找陈初阳。
“没有。”
陈初阳可是知道这件事情的重要性，他可不会轻易答应，到时候，他父母肯定会剥了他的皮。
“商红尘，你想退婚可以，去找我父母，他们同意了，我这边自然没有问题。”
商红尘眉头紧锁，盯着陈初阳。
“你去说行不行？”
陈初阳就知道事情没这么简单，这个女人果然是这么打算的，正所谓无事不登三宝殿，此女第一次来这座山，他就知道没好事。
这是要让他扛下所有事情，这不是找死吗？陈初阳可不会做这种事情，也不会……被父母捉住了把柄，好不容易一个人生活，他岂能……再回去。
“别，你别搞我，我可不想挨揍。”
“你想要退婚，你去说，我不去。”
陈重阳也不想这么快结婚，对于商红尘，说实话，也就那样，不太熟悉。
碍于父母的情况，他只能被动答应而已。
content_en:
Daqi Dynasty.
Dragon Snake City.
The gentleness of March ruffled the bright sky. A young man was sitting on a mountain. In front of him was a girl. The girl stood with a sword. The tree next to her swayed and dropped a few green leaves. The girl's sword had been unsheathed, and the leaves were cut in half. The neat cuts were filled with the fierceness of the sword.
The girl's eyes were cold, but she was only twenty-eight years old. She pointed her sword at the boy, raised her beautiful eyes, and said coldly: "Chen Chuyang, it is impossible for you and me. It is impossible for me to marry you, and it is impossible for me to stay in the small Dragon and Snake City for the rest of my life."
The young man in front of him was named Chen Chuyang. Hearing this, he raised his eyes slightly and glanced at the girl.
"Oh."
The return was calm and uneventful, not as angry or violent as expected. That oh made Shang Hongchen frown, her eyes became sharper, and her sword aura was about to break out of the sword.
The girl took a step forward, her momentum oppressive.
"Chen Chuyang, I'm telling you something serious. Can you be more serious? I want to leave Dragon Snake City. It's impossible for me to get married to you. This time I come to you to break off the engagement. It's absolutely impossible between you and me. Therefore, the previous engagement made by my father is invalid."
Unilateral notification does not require his consent.
Shang Hongchen's purpose was self-evident. Chen Chuyang raised his head and responded again: "Oh."
The girl exploded, and she took another step forward. The sword in her hand was only a fist away from Chen Chuyang. If she moved any further, it would pierce the boy's neck and kill him. The girl's control of the distance was very wonderful. Being stuck at this distance, she could not only threaten Chen Chuyang, but also make him feel uncomfortable and dare not resist.
The girl's will is firm, and the engagement between the two must be canceled.
Chen Chuyang looked at the girl in front of him, Shang Hongchen, the eldest daughter of the merchant, a famous beauty in Dragon Snake City, and the dream lover of many young disciples. The Chen family and the merchant were allies. The friendship between the two families lasted a hundred years ago. Each generation of family heads would make some marriage contracts to increase their friendship with each other.
It just so happened that Chen Chuyang and Shang Hongchen were similar in age. They were born in the same year and were engaged to each other.
The two were childhood sweethearts, but Chen Chuyang was a homebody. He mostly stayed in the mountains of the Chen family, farming, raising fish, and concentrating on doing his own things. He was not from this world, but came from another world. He became a baby when he opened his eyes. After more than ten years of tragic life, he finally became an adult.
He has always hidden his various adult consciousnesses, for fear of being regarded as a monster, and did not dare to show it too obviously, so he always liked to live alone and felt that those people were too naive, so naturally the news came out that Chen Chuyang was an ordinary person, very ordinary.
This world is a world of cultivation. When Chen Chuyang learned this, he also embarked on the path of cultivation like everyone else. However, his path of cultivation was different, very different from others.
The girl in front of her was a well-known genius in Dragon Snake City. Her talent was very scary. She was one of the best in Dragon Snake City. It was said that she was favored by some sects and wanted to be accepted as a disciple. Then, the scene before her happened.
"Chen Chuyang, did you agree?"
Shang Hongchen was a little happy. She thought this road would be difficult, but her father did not agree to break off the engagement. After all, it was related to the relationship between the two families. Moreover, Chen Chuyang was just an ordinary person, not a waste, nor a dissolute child, so he had met his standards.
The engagement agreement was that the wedding would be held when the two came of age. No, they were still a few months away from starting preparations for the marriage. Shang Hongchen was unwilling and wanted to break off the engagement. After being rejected, she came to find Chen Chuyang herself.
"No."
Chen Chuyang knows the importance of this matter, and he will not agree easily. When the time comes, his parents will definitely skin him.
"Shang Hongchen, if you want to break off the engagement, you can go to my parents. They agree, so of course there will be no problem on my side."
Shang Hongchen frowned and stared at Chen Chuyang.
"Can you go and say it?"
Chen Chuyang knew that things were not that simple. This woman had indeed planned to do so. As the saying goes, no matter what happened, he would not go to the Three Treasures Hall. The first time this woman came to this mountain, he knew that nothing good was going to happen.
This is asking him to shoulder everything. Isn't this asking for death? Chen Chuyang would not do such a thing, nor would he... After being caught by his parents and finally living alone, how could he... go back again.
"No, don't mess with me, I don't want to get beaten."
"If you want to break off the engagement, you go ahead and say it, but I won't go."
Chen Chongyang didn't want to get married so soon. To be honest, he was just like that and not very familiar with Shang Hongchen.
Due to his parents' situation, he could only passively agree.
title_en: Chapter 1: Broken Engagement by Shang Hongchen Chapter 2: The Second Level of Hunyuan Dao Realm
